summary.intent: Run Session 1 of the v1-alpha launch plan for the callisto repo: fix pre-cycle aggregation (F1), drive release-PR decide from the version plan (F2), and build Changesets v3 pre.json support (G), managed prerelease (H) and status --since (M), then shepherd G (#571) through review rounds.
summary.outcome: F1 (#566) and F2 (#567) were pushed as draft PRs, and G, H and M were built and gated locally. G (#571) was merged with main twice and pushed with several Entire review fixes. The final idempotent-archive fix and the archived-note ambiguity status fix were still mid-gate and not yet pushed.

repo: Worktree branch names differ from PR branch names, so a plain `git push` silently no-ops; push `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` and verify with `git ls-remote`.
Never commit `mutants.out*`; restore `mutants.out.old` from HEAD after mutants runs, since the G branch had been tracking 137 such files.
The gate is `just pre-push`, `lint`, `doc-check`, `test` and `ci`, each judged by exit code. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is set to cores/5 (earlier cores/4).
Commits must be signed, with no trailer, and GitHub's verification reason should read `valid`.
Spec criteria live in docs/specs/*.json and must be updated with behavior changes. Docs such as docs/releasing.md and docs/errors.md also mention E165 wording.
Release decision schema moved to v3 with a `consumedChangesets` field. E165 now checks the deleted changesets match the recorded set (`ConsumedChangesetsDiffer`).
Pre-cycle semantics: a package with any fresh input (a new changeset, inference, or a group member) still counts its retained changesets toward severity, while retained-only input releases nothing.
Mid-cycle package removal or ambiguity in archived `.changeset/pre/` notes must surface in `status` diagnostics, otherwise `status --check` passes while `version` fails.

code.finding: The `Seed`/`Source` types replaced `NamedBy`. `Source::is_fresh` distinguishes retained changesets from fresh input, and `Aggregation.severities()`/`reasons()` are now derived from seeds.
Aggregation errors (ParseChangeset, AmbiguousName) were suppressed here, so archived notes had to be added explicitly to the well-formedness diagnostic scan.
The archive move deletes its source, so resume failed. The plan now carries the archived note text, and a missing source whose archive copy holds exactly that text counts as done.

workflow: Writing tests first and confirming red by reverting the fix (red.sh) gave reliable regression proof.
Running cargo-mutants on each diff caught real test gaps, such as an unchecked unknown-package warning at exit and a redundant README check.
Peer sessions can send cross-session instructions mid-run. Merge main (no rebase, no force-push) and re-gate on the merged tree before pushing.
A gate run in the background must be stopped and restarted when the tree changes, because it would otherwise test a stale tree.

friction: The G subagent kept re-sending the same report and had to be stopped.
The cargo-mutants filters initially named a test binary that existed only on another branch, and the package flags did not apply, so the runs failed and needed rewriting.
A sandbox-blocked `sed` edit let an unchanged script start again.
F1's full suite was slow (1924 tests), and the `just ci` audit step failed on RUSTSEC-2026-0542 until #560 merged.
Several merge conflicts with main arose as sibling PRs (#570, #575, #577) landed ahead of G.
The first interrupted-run test failed because the decision path is checked before apply, so the test switched to blocking the --emit-preview write instead.
Review findings kept arriving on #571 over multiple rounds.
open_items: Finish the archived-note ambiguity fix: run the status test and pre_v3 tests, commit it, then re-gate the merged tree including `just ci`.
Push the idempotent-archive fix, the main merge and the ambiguity fix in one push with an explicit refspec and `ls-remote`, then resolve the Entire findings 01M7RBYQ9KY9 and 01M7RDA9X3WF.
Run mutants on the final diff.
Ship H once #571 merges: rebase onto main, re-gate, push, and open it on trail #457. M (trail #458) still needs a rebase, `just ci` and a PR.
Stale release PRs that delete no changesets are not caught by E165, so only the Hold workflow and the manifest check stop them.
Re-running `version` locally before the prerelease is tagged re-infers the same commits for `release-trigger = auto` packages.
A linked-group target uses `named_severity`, which excludes group-raised severity, a low finding from the F1 review.
Further Entire findings on #571 go to the lead unfixed unless they break recovery or give wrong results.
